feature: Reference edition and coverage of A/324 in national documents

ATSC.value: Baseline: A/324:2025-04 (incl. 2025-01 Amd 1 and Corrigendum 1) with references updated 2025-07 and 2026-04 — no technical change after 2025-04

TTA.clause: Part 4 §2 인용 표준 (A/324 Candidate Standard revision of A/324:2018, 2020.01); 서문 3.2 비교표 (부록 Ⅰ-2 = A/324 §7, §8 동일(번역)); §1.2 (SFN/STL 분배 인터페이스 언급)
TTA.value: Only DSTP (§7) and ALPTP (§8) are translated (부록 Ⅰ-2). Scheduler/BGW management (§5), CTP (§6), STLTP (§9) and transmitter requirements (§10) are not part of the Korean standard; TxID/BSID operation is covered by the technical report TTAR-07.0026/R1
TTA.req: DSTP/ALPTP normative; STLTP not standardized nationally

SBTVD.value: A/324:2025-07 incorporated by reference for transmitters and retransmitters; content identical to the 2026-04 baseline (reference updates only)

difference: Korea standardizes only the data-source side (DSTP/ALPTP, from the 2020 candidate revision) and leaves STL transport, scheduler and transmitter requirements to vendor implementation plus a national TxID/BSID guideline; Brazil incorporates the whole of A/324:2025-07, which is technically identical to the baseline.
impact: Korean gateway–exciter links are not bound to STLTP by standard (interoperability relies on A/324 as de facto practice); Brazilian transmitters must implement STLTP per regulation.

TTA.text: DSTP/ALPTP translated (2020 CS); STLTP, CTP, scheduler and transmitter clauses not standardized in Korea

SBTVD.text: Referenced edition technically identical to baseline (2025-04 content); ABNT NBR 25601 profile unverified

feature: Data Source Transport Protocol (DSTP) and ALP Transport Protocol (ALPTP)

ATSC.value: RTP-tunneled data-source and ALP packet transport, incl. Emergency Alert wake-up RTP control

TTA.clause: 부록 Ⅰ-2.1 DSTP (Ⅰ-2.1.1 개요, Ⅰ-2.1.1.1 매핑 설정, Ⅰ-2.1.2 설계, Ⅰ-2.1.2.2 Emergency Alert Wakeup RTP 제어); 부록 Ⅰ-2.2 ALPTP
TTA.value: Translation of A/324 CS (2020-01) §7–§8 per the TTA comparison table

difference: Same protocols; Korea's text is the 2020 candidate revision (changes in A/324:2021 → 2025-04 amendments/corrigendum not itemized here).

TTA.text: Translation of §7–§8; 2021–2025 amendment deltas not yet itemized

feature: STLTP, Common Tunneling Protocol, scheduler/BGW management and SFN timing

ATSC.clause: §5 Scheduler (5.3 BGW management protocol, 5.5 DSCP); §6 CTP (6.4 tunneled packet security); §9 STLTP (9.2 preamble data generator, 9.3 timing and management, 9.5 channel bonding); §10 transmitter requirements (10.1 timing manager); Annex F MIMO configuration
ATSC.value: Normative STL transport and SFN timing/management

TTA.clause: Part 4 §1.2 (SFN/STL 분배 인터페이스 존재 언급); Notice Art. 13 ② 1 (SFN 주파수허용편차 ±2.1 Hz)
TTA.value: No national STLTP/CTP text; SFN frequency tolerance fixed by regulation (±2.1 Hz)
TTA.req: not standardized (regulation on SFN tolerance only)

SBTVD.value: STLTP and transmitter requirements incorporated; conformity assessment of transmitters/retransmitters

difference: Korea has no standard for the studio-to-transmitter link or transmitter timing beyond the regulatory SFN tolerance; Brazil incorporates A/324 in full and tests transmitters against it.
impact: Korean broadcasters rely on A/324-compatible equipment de facto; formal conformance is not defined nationally.
recommendation: Consider adopting A/324 §9–§10 (STLTP, transmitter requirements) in a future TTA revision or guideline.

TTA.text: No Korean standard for STLTP/CTP/transmitter requirements

feature: Transmitter identification (TxID) and broadcast stream identifier (BSID) assignment

ATSC.clause: A/322 Annex N (TxID signal, Table N.3.1 injection levels); A/324 §5 (TxID control from BGW), L1D_bsid
ATSC.value: Gold-code DSBSS RF watermark in the first preamble symbol; injection level codes; BSID in SLT@bsid and L1D_bsid

TTA.clause: Part 4 부록 Ⅰ-1.12 송신기 식별부호 (translation of Annex N); TTAR §5 (TxID 적용·운용·확인), §6 방송사별 TxID 할당 규칙 (KBS/EBS/OBS, MBC, 민영), §7 BSID 할당 규칙 (DTV TSID 방식, SLT@bsid = L1D_bsid), <표 5-1> recommended maximum injection level per L1 mode, 부록 Ⅱ BSID 할당표
TTA.page: Part 4 doc p.343–349; TTAR doc p.2–11
TTA.value: National allocation scheme: 4-digit TxID per broadcaster/region, STL-mode (BGW) or MANUAL-mode activation, ≥ −24 dB recommended in SFN overlap areas; BSID unique per broadcaster following the DTV TSID plan
TTA.req: TxID optional (activated on demand); BSID mandatory

SBTVD.clause: Decreto Art. 3º III (Ferramenta de Identificação de Transmissor – TxID)
SBTVD.value: TxID mandated as a TV 3.0 feature; allocation rules not published

difference: The TxID mechanism is identical (A/322 Annex N); Korea adds a national allocation and operating guideline (TTAR-07.0026/R1) while keeping TxID optional; Brazil makes TxID mandatory by decree but has no published allocation scheme.
impact: Requirement level differs (optional vs mandatory); national numbering plans are needed for interference analysis and SFN tuning.

SBTVD.text: Same mechanism; TxID mandatory by decree
